name: Growth strategy
summary: Grow revenue organically (more customers, more per customer, new products, new markets: the Ansoff matrix) or inorganically (acquisitions, partnerships). Prioritise by size of prize, feasibility and risk.
opening_line: Revenue can grow organically, by selling more of what we have or adding new products and markets, or inorganically through acquisitions and partnerships. I'd size each option and prioritise by impact and feasibility.
when_to_use: Client wants to grow revenue or hit a revenue target
Revenue has stalled, but margins are fine
when_not_to_use: Profit is falling because of costs: use profitability
The question is one specific market or deal: use market entry or M&A

buckets.name: Core business
questions: Can we raise price, frequency or basket size?

buckets.name: Adjacencies
questions: Which adjacent products or markets fit our capabilities?

buckets.name: Inorganic
questions: Are there targets that accelerate growth?
